data.name: results/paimana/panel.csv
data.description: 17010 rows, 2195 projects, 11 monthly MoSPI PAIMANA Flash Reports (2025-09 to 2026-07), parsed and reconciled against each report's printed totals. Public data; no personal data.

components.name: ANUMAAN slip model
components.description: Probability that a project's stated completion date moves in the next monthly report.

inputs.format: tabular: original_cost_cr, revised_cost_cr, cumulative_expenditure_cr, physical_progress_pct, months_since_approval, cumulative_drift_months, months_to_target, months_past_original, expenditure_ratio, cost_overrun_ratio, exp_progress_divergence, drift_change_1m, date_revised_this_month, revisions_so_far, cost_revised_this_month, months_observed, months_since_last_revision, ministry

useCases: rank projects for review before each monthly meeting
technicalLimitations: predicts the agency's next revision of the date, not the final overrun

properties.name: training_code_source
properties.value: def fit_lightgbm(X_train, y_train): clf = lgb.LGBMClassifier( n_estimators=200, learning_rate=0.05, num_leaves=15, min_child_samples=50, random_state=0, verbosity=-1, ) clf.fit(X_train, y_train) return clf

properties.name: validation
properties.value: walk-forward by month; no random split

components.name: receptron/laya-onnx
components.description: Laya, the open-weights Jev-compatible System-1 decision model, run locally via ONNX Runtime (@receptron/laya) to triage field remarks to a delay cause.

useCases: suggest the delay cause and owner for a field remark
technicalLimitations: 12-option cause probabilities are not calibrated; used as a ranking only
auto-routing only when P(describes a delaying problem) >= taxonomy min_confidence

properties.name: runs
properties.value: on the ANUMAAN server CPU; no hosted API
